blocks.prompt: 4. The A.M. of two numbers is 7 and their product is 45. Find the numbers.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh word problem (ibarat wala sawal) hai jis mein do numbers maloom karne hain. Do unknowns ke liye do maloomat chahiye, aur sawal do de raha hai: A.M. 7 hai aur product (zarb) 45 hai.
Plan: har jumle ko equation mein badlenge, ek equation se ek unknown nikal kar doosri mein rakhenge, phir quadratic equation solve karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: do numbers ka A.M. 7 hai aur un ka product 45 hai
Humein find karna hai: woh do numbers.
Tareeqa: Numbers ko \(a\) aur \(b\) kahenge. \(\frac{a + b}{2} = 7\) aur \(ab = 45\). Pehli equation se \(b = 14 - a\) nikal kar doosri mein rakhenge, to sirf ek unknown wali equation bachegi.

Jumlon ko equations mein badlein
\[\dfrac{a + b}{2} = 7 \Rightarrow a + b = 14\]
\[ab = 45\]
Kyun: "A.M. 7 hai" ka matlab average 7 hai; dono taraf 2 se multiply karne par jama 14 mil gaya. "Product 45 hai" seedha \(ab = 45\) hai.

Sirf \(a\) wali equation banayein
\[b = 14 - a\]
\[a(14 - a) = 45\]
\[14a - a^2 = 45\]
\[a^2 - 14a + 45 = 0\]
Kyun: \(b\) ki jagah \(14 - a\) rakha, bracket khola, aur sab terms ek taraf le aaye taake quadratic equation standard shakal \(a^2 + \ldots = 0\) mein aa jaye. Ab yeh factorise ho sakti hai.

Factorise kar ke solve karein
\[(a - 5)(a - 9) = 0\]
\[a = 5 \text{ or } a = 9\]
Kyun: Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product \(+45\) aur jama \(-14\) ho: \(-5\) aur \(-9\). Do brackets ka product zero ho to koi ek bracket zero hoga, is liye \(a = 5\) ya \(a = 9\).

Doosra number nikalein aur tasdeeq karein
\[a = 5 \Rightarrow b = 9\]
\[a = 9 \Rightarrow b = 5\]
\[\dfrac{5 + 9}{2} = 7,\ 5 \times 9 = 45 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono suraton mein numbers ka jora wahi hai: 5 aur 9, sirf tarteeb badli hai. A.M. 7 aur product 45, dono shartein poori hain.
Dhyan dein: sirf \(a = 5\) likh kar ruk jana adhoora jawab hai; sawal do numbers maangta hai.
